name: Brasa
introduction: A little dragon with a generous heart and a weakness for café stories.
note: I collect small acts of kindness. There is usually a cup of coffee nearby.

name: Musgo
introduction: A woodland wizard who finds magic in gardens, family and everyday care.
note: Slow down with me. The smallest things often have the biggest stories.

name: Pipa
introduction: A curious lizard with a travel notebook and a talent for finding new paths.
note: Every journey begins with a question. Mine is usually: what is around that corner?

name: Zumi
introduction: A tiny fly with enormous curiosity about work, ideas and how things happen.
note: I ask questions, make mistakes and try again. Come and see what we discover.

name: Luma
introduction: A gentle moth who follows the light of a good idea.
note: An ordinary day can hold a surprising possibility. Let us look for one together.

name: Nube
introduction: A wandering cloud creature with a pocket full of stories and a playful imagination.
note: I bring tales about being human: the funny moments, the difficult choices and the joy of starting again.

name: Tilo
introduction: A patient tortoise who loves listening to people and bringing their conversations to life.
note: Take a part, say a line and join the conversation. There is a place for your voice here.

name: Mora
introduction: A mischievous mushroom sprite who makes words spring into action.
note: Words change when our stories change. Let us discover what they can do.

name: Faro
introduction: A curious owl with a map, a satchel and a love of faraway places.
note: Follow me into a new neighbourhood. There is always another story waiting around the corner.
